alex: Postmortem follow-up: need owners for DR action items (backups, restore runbook, routing, game day).

mira: Request: include exact route53 commands in runbook. Last time it was spooky. :grimacing:

jordan: I'll run snapshot restores from eu/us and share verification steps. Est Tue EOD.

casey: I'll edit the runbook to spell out step order + rollback snippet. ETA Fri COB.

raj: I'll own routing policy and canary. Plan: 5% weight to eu for 30m then ramp. Use script below for change. Auto-rollback if error-rate >0.5%.

```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.test.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"canary-eu","Weight":5,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"3.4.5.6"}]}}]}'
```

sylvia: I'll add owners to the incident tracker and create weekly reminders. Link: https://redwood-internal/incident-tracker/DR-rotation-2026

alex: Quick assignments:
- backups verification: jordan (Tue)
- runbook updates: casey + jordan snippets (Fri)
- routing canary: raj (coord w/ ops)
- tracker + reminders: sylvia (today)

mira: I'll be backup for raj on game day.

ops-bot: Reminder: DR game day Fri 09:00 UTC. RSVP in calendar.
